description: This Java class provides utility functions for extracting and analyzing HTTP request headers and cookies within a security context, especially focusing on authorization headers, Basic Auth credentials, and header retrieval from Akka HTTP request contexts.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for extracting headers, cookies, and performing authorization checks on HTTP requests within the Akka HTTP framework.

methods.name: getRequestHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header from the given request context, returning an Optional that contains the header value if present.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Extracts all headers and cookies from the provided RequestContext and returns them encapsulated within a RequestHeaders object.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationForPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the request contains an authorization header starting with the specified prefix.

methods.name: basicAuthUsernameMatches
methods.description: Verifies if the username in the Basic Authentication header matches a provided UUID pattern.
